Keith is an ancestor of Andrew, who is an ancestor of Bryan, who is an ancestor of Jordan.  
Cynthia is a descendant of Jordan, so Keith is also an ancestor of Cynthia. From Cynthia, the given relationships lead (through Cynthia → Katherine → … → Billy → Linda → Kelly → Sophia) to Betty, who is a descendant of Sophia.

Therefore, Keith is Betty’s ancestor.

<ANSWER>2</ANSWER>
